name: data
lead: Helpers for persistent data views. Player.data remains an ordinary Lua table.

functions.name: copy
functions.description: A detached JSON snapshot as ordinary Lua values/tables.

functions.name: insert
functions.signature: data.insert((list: DataView, value: any) -> ()) → & ((list: DataView, index: number, value: any) -> ())
functions.description: Insert into a nested data list; omitted index appends.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Remove and return a detached value; omitted index removes the last element.
